final_message:
COMPLETE
I modified `pyproject.toml` to explicitly include the `src/pytest_html/resources/` directory in the wheel build target. This ensures that the necessary static assets (`app.js`, `style.css`, etc.) are bundled within the package distribution. The HTML template (`index.jinja2`) already uses `{% include "app.js" %}`, which should correctly reference the bundled asset when the package is installed, allowing the report to be self-contained and usable without external dependencies like npm. I verified the inclusion mechanism by inspecting the template and confirmed the packaging change.
